Julien Cazarre, c'est l'humoriste frança: Julien Cazarre is the French comedian who built his career around football with a completely offbeat approach. Having come through cult Canal+ programmes (Action Discrète, J+1, Le Vrai Journal) and then hilarious segments on L'After Foot on RMC, he doesn't do classic stand-up: he takes sport as raw material and mixes in parodies, impressions, absurd debates, gleeful bad faith and a strong sense of nonsense.
Les Nuits du Cazarre enchaîné, c'est sa: Les Nuits du Cazarre enchaîné is his late-night open-line show on RMC, co-hosted with Jean-Christophe Drouet — after big matches or in the middle of the night, when the atmosphere is naturally freer and wilder. It has almost become his creative showcase.
Anecdotes de supporters en direct, joute: Live fan anecdotes, verbal sparring with listeners, impressions, debates about football's most absurd topics. It feels like hanging out with friends — but the most twisted, funniest friend you've ever had.
Un one man show permanent mais interacti: A permanent but interactive one-man show, in the heat of the news, with a dose of absurdity that easily surpasses what you see on stage. Completely unpredictable segments.
Cazarre n'est jamais parti dans le stand: Cazarre never went into "classic" stand-up: he invented hybrid formats blending comedy, radio, interaction and sport. Apple Podcasts rating: 4.6/5 (614 ratings) — the fans know what they're doing.
Pour Alex, Cazarre n'est pas juste un hu: For Alex, Cazarre isn't just a "football" comedian — he's the ultimate comic, all categories combined. Why? Because he's unique: surprising, baroque, completely unpredictable. His humour doesn't just tell jokes, it reinvents how we relate to sport, mocks clichés, ridicules received ideas, subverts real situations — all in constant dialogue with his audience.
C'est ça qui fait un grand comique : pas: That's what makes a great comic: not just a good punchline, but a worldview. And he has one. If you don't know Cazarre yet, Les Nuits du Cazarre enchaîné may be the format that makes you rediscover football… while laughing.
